candidates.name: Dillapiole

evidence.observation_time: Growth followed for five weeks; dose-response endpoint reported over this assay.
evidence.model_use: Fitted concentration endpoint; ppm basis must be curated before cross-study potency modelling
evidence.transcription_notes: Authors’ fitted estimate; no confidence interval supplied. Fig 3 not digitized. IC50/IC95 from the same curve are not independent replicates.
evidence.limitations: No confidence intervals supplied for fitted IC values. Preserve ppm as reported; do not silently convert to molarity. Extract and pure-compound curves differ.
evidence.source_locator: PDF 4–5 / printed 671–672; Figs 1–3 and results prose

candidates.name: Caryophyllene epoxide

evidence.source_plant: Hymenaea courbaril; Melampodium divaricatum; Vismea baccifera [as printed; Vismia linkage]
evidence.source_organ: Leaves; previously reported origin, assay-batch provenance unresolved
evidence.fungus_as_reported: Mutualistic attine fungus; pure-culture identity confirmed by ant acceptance.
evidence.observation_time: Table 1 endpoint is day 7; growth was also followed through day 28.
evidence.model_use: Ordinal dose-conditioned response; group both doses and all plant links within the same material/study
evidence.transcription_notes: Plant origins from PDF 3; do not expand one assay into independent rows for each plant. No growth at one dose is not a measured MIC.
evidence.limitations: Mapped percentages retain ordinal measurement resolution. Table concentrations take precedence over approximate method concentrations. Historical plant origins do not establish batch origin or garden exposure. Possible culture-lineage overlap with 1983 study is unverified.

limitations: Dose slots are labels; no biological doses, volumes or incubation times are assigned.
One proposed isolate per fungus does not establish species-wide susceptibility.
Technical wells are not independent biological replicates; runs retain separate IDs.
The 96-well layout is a capacity illustration, not an approved format for every fungus.
Normalize within each validated assay; do not pool raw growth or mix MIC with IC50.
Unknown and untested outcomes remain unknown; broad activity requires valid measured data.
New measurements belong in prospective validation, separate from the frozen analysis.
